summary: Steep residential kerb where cars park; homes 10-20 m away on both sides.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11-22 m on the kerb side and homes across the road; no bush or park backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb parking with parked cars on both sides; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted; overnight outside those hours; cars parked along it.

flags: Mapped gate 56 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy over the west kerb; afternoon sun from the west mostly screened by trees.

best_section.where: Woodstock Avenue west kerb, midway down the hill from the top junction
